div.div: مُتْلَئِبٌّ [Uniform or undeviating,] right, or rightly directed or ordered [&c.: see the verb]; as also مُسْلَحِبٌّ. (Asudot;, T) Also applied to a rule, (A, TA,) as meaning Uniform, undeviating, or of general application; uniformly, or constantly, obtaining. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
